title: universalHomeomorphism_composition
statement: For a universal homeomorphism u : X' → X and a universal homeomorphism v : X'' → X', the etale-set, Type-valued lower-star, additive upper-star, and additive lower-star functors for u ∘ v have the stated compositor isomorphisms; these compositors identify the two successive cohomology pullback maps with cohomologyMap (u ∘ v).

proof.text: Use the three continuous-functor sheaf pullback adjunctions for u, v and v ≫ u. Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso transports lowerStarComp to the left adjoints; invert this isomorphism to obtain the displayed set-valued compositor.

Use lowerStarComp for the Type-valued and additive pushforward compositors and upperStarComp for the additive inverse-image compositor. The composition clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial expresses successive pullback as Sheaf.H.map of the forward compositor applied to pullback along v ≫ u. Apply Sheaf.H.map of the inverse compositor; functoriality of Sheaf.H.map and the inverse-hom identity cancel these maps and give the displayed equality.

lean.statement: theorem universalHomeomorphism_composition {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (u : X' ⟶ X) [IsUniversalHomeomorphism u] : ∀ (X'' : Scheme.{u}) (v : X'' ⟶ X'), IsUniversalHomeomorphism v → Nonempty (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (v ≫ u) ≅ Scheme.etaleSetPullback u ⋙ Scheme.etaleSetPullback v) ∧ Nonempty (lowerStar (Type (u + 1)) (v ≫ u) ≅ lowerStar (Type (u + 1)) v ⋙ lowerStar (Type (u + 1)) u) ∧ Nonempty (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v ≫ u) ≅ upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} u ⋙ upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v) ∧ Nonempty (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v ≫ u) ≅ lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v ⋙ lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} u) ∧ ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H F q), Sheaf.H.map ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v u).inv.app F) q (cohomologyMap v ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} u).obj F) q (cohomologyMap u F q x)) = cohomologyMap (v ≫ u) F q x
